verdict.rationale: Groq's own docs describe how rate limits change across tiers: upgrading to paid unlocks higher token limits, Flex processing gives 10x higher rate limits than on-demand, and Batch does not count against standard rate limits. However, the pack contains no dedicated rate-limits page with concrete per-model or per-tier numbers. missing for 10: a documented rate-limits reference with concrete RPM/TPM values per model and tier, documentation of rate-limit headers or 429 behavior, explicit free-vs-developer tier limit tables, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits and how they scale across usage tiers before I hit them in production

citations.quote: Flex processing is available for all models to paid customers only with 10x higher rate limits compared to on-demand processing.
